quotations.english: it will seek each of those bearing life

source_text: feorh-berende; part. Life-bearing, living; v&i-long;tam f&e-short;rens, v&i-long;vens :-- Heó wile gesécan ǽghwylcne feorhberendra it will seek each of those bearing life, Exon. 110 a; Th. 420, 19; Rä. 40, 6: Cd. 92; Th. 117, 17; Gen. 1955.
